opening-montage.location: Branford Train Station / Streets / Marsh Edge
opening-montage.keyElements: Dallas arrival montage intercut with Asher planting acoustic traps and reacting to the hum
opening-montage.productionNotes: No dialogue. Preserve Asher’s woods equipment: trail cameras, boom pole, acoustic traps, folding trowel, and concealed microphone array.

property-manager.keyElements: Dallas meets property manager. First full view of Dallas's face in attic.
property-manager.productionNotes: Kinetic tour with fragmented shots. Camera goes still in attic. Dallas does not say he'll take the house.

branford-night-discovery.productionNotes: Dallas discovers weirdness of neighborhood and tall grass

dallas-marsh-walk.productionNotes: Dallas tracks the sound alone through Branford neighborhoods toward the marsh

the-field-journal.keyElements: Dallas and Asher compare Sierra’s field journal, the creature drawings, the red-eye transformation, the marsh listening posts, and the repeating signal pattern.
the-field-journal.productionNotes: Preserve the quiet Dallas/Asher triangulation beat at the picnic table: journal pages, bead string, listening-post map logic, and the warning that the creatures are listening.

the-tracking-box.keyElements: Asher leads Dallas and Dominic through his listening-post network to the hidden woods lair, demonstrating the amber nodes, bead count, trail cameras, recorders, cables, and spare oscillator.
the-tracking-box.productionNotes: Preserve Asher’s practical woods equipment and continuity: blinking amber listening posts, bead string, wooden chest, trail cameras, pocket tripod, pocket microphone, cables, contact transducers, and spare oscillator.

marsh-confrontation.keyElements: Dallas and Dominic load out at the marsh edge. Dallas carries the oscillator, Asher’s spare, tracker, cable, and portable speaker from Asher’s woods lair; Dominic carries the baby creature and takes point.
marsh-confrontation.productionNotes: Two-person marsh unit. Asher remains off screen; his established recorder network and woods equipment are essential to Dallas’s plan.

predator-attack.keyElements: Dallas and Dominic cross ten-foot grass in the storm, lose the tracker signal, hide beneath a Red-Eye patrol, and continue toward the center with the baby.
predator-attack.productionNotes: Two principal actors in the marsh. Dallas leads with tracker, chest-rig LED, and handheld speaker; Dominic protects the creature.

the-perimeter.keyElements: Dallas and Dominic reunite the baby with its mother, then face the Red-Eye siege. Dallas’s handheld speaker fails and he begins routing the creature’s call through Asher’s recorder network.
the-perimeter.productionNotes: Two principal actors plus creature effects. Preserve the recorder-network payoff established in Asher’s woods scenes.

the-last-dinner.keyElements: Dallas broadcasts the rebuilt creature call through every recorder in the marsh. The network converges, the Red-Eyes collapse, the mother dies protecting the baby, and Dominic leads Dallas home.
the-last-dinner.productionNotes: Dallas and Dominic carry the climax. No house intercut and no additional family cast.

shotList.title: Train station arrival
shotList.description: Dallas exits train at Branford station, picks up suitcase, walks toward station exit. Long Island Sound visible beyond.

shotList.title: Walking through Branford streets (montage)
shotList.description: Dallas walks through residential Branford while Asher works alone in the marsh, planting trail cameras, a boom pole, and concealed acoustic traps.

shotList.title: Property Manager House Tour
shotList.description: Dallas meets property manager at front door and tours rental house. Progresses from foyer through living room, kitchen, backyard observation, and attic.

shotList.title: Property Manager Scene Pickups
shotList.description: Pickup shots for the property manager house tour. Focus on close-ups, transitions, and alternate angles from Day 0 shoot.

shotList.title: Kitchen hum
shotList.description: Dallas settles into the kitchen, clocks the first faint hum, and marks the frequency before the sound cuts.

shotList.title: Driveway edge
shotList.description: Dallas steps outside, watches the driveway and the property line, and feels the hum merge out of the tall grass.

shotList.title: Attic boxes
shotList.description: In the attic, Dallas opens Sierra's box, finds the field notes, cassette player, headphones, and old recorder.

shotList.title: Bathroom tape
shotList.description: The shower drowns everything out until the cassette tape and the distant hum start bleeding into the bathroom.

shotList.title: Downstairs pulse
shotList.description: Downstairs, Dallas records the pulsing tone, tracks the pattern, and loses the battery mid-read.

shotList.title: House exterior glow
shotList.description: Outside again, Dallas watches the grass sway as the golden glow pulses and a storm builds over Branford.

shotList.title: Opening montage - Branford locations
shotList.description: Montage coverage across 5-10 Branford locations with gimbal work

shotList.title: The Field Journal
shotList.description: Dallas and Asher triangulate Sierra’s journal drawings, Asher’s bead-counted listening posts, and the bright-to-dark creature transformation.

shotList.title: The Almost Discovery
shotList.description: Dallas hides the creature and equipment while Dominic nearly discovers the humming enclosure.

shotList.title: Remaining s02 coverage
shotList.description: Continuation of s02 from Day 1 — pick up any remaining beats not completed.

shotList.title: The Confrontation
shotList.description: Asher finds the trailcam path, discovers the creature in Dallas’s attic, tests it with his oscillator and viewfinder, and agrees to keep the secret.

shotList.title: The Connection
shotList.description: Dominic and Dallas discuss grief; Asher’s seizure and amplifier reveal a second signal coming from the marsh.

shotList.title: Into the Grass
shotList.description: Dominic runs after the creature and Dallas follows with the tracker as red eyes flare at the grass line.

shotList.title: The Load-Out
shotList.description: Dallas loads Asher’s spare oscillator and retrieves the portable speaker from Asher’s woods lair while Dominic carries the baby and takes point.

shotList.title: The Trench Run
shotList.description: Dallas and Dominic lose the tracker signal, hide beneath a Red-Eye patrol, and push deeper through the storm with the baby.

shotList.title: The Mother and the Swarm
shotList.description: Dominic reunites the baby with its mother as Dallas detects the siege and routes the creature’s call toward Asher’s recorder network.

shotList.title: The Answer
shotList.description: Dallas’s broadcast pulls every marsh recorder into an amplified halo, collapsing the Red-Eyes; Dominic guides Dallas home after the creatures disappear.

shotList.title: The Morning After
shotList.description: Dallas and Dominic return through the grass and enter the house soaked and exhausted.

shotList.title: The Coordinates
shotList.description: Dallas sees Asher’s basement map and equipment while Mr. Mike scratches the repeating coordinates and warns that the song has gone wrong.

shotList.title: Life Group Arrives
shotList.description: Dallas and Dominic hide and stabilize the creature in the basement while life group fills the house and Mr. Mike senses the danger.

shotList.title: The Hymn
shotList.description: The life-group hymn aligns with the creature’s hum; Mr. Mike identifies the golden target and the Red-Eyes outside.

shotList.title: The Secret Is Out
shotList.description: Dominic discovers Sierra’s creature files, sees the Red-Eyes, and joins Dallas in testing the portable speaker against them.

shotList.title: Into the neighborhoods
shotList.description: Dallas tracks the pulsing hum through suburban streets and toward the marsh.

shotList.title: Marsh edge approach
shotList.description: Dallas reaches the tall marsh, realizes the sound is intensifying from the grass itself.

shotList.title: Nursery exploration
shotList.description: Dallas searches the East Haven Nursery grounds with oscillator, tracking the frequency.

shotList.title: The injured creature
shotList.description: Dallas discovers something in the tall grass - evidence of an animal or disturbance.

shotList.title: Jerry's house approach
shotList.description: Dallas arrives at Jerry's house in evening darkness, oscillator still active.

shotList.title: Something in the shadows
shotList.description: Dallas hears movement or shadows around the house perimeter - the hum intensifies.

shotList.title: Mr. Mike’s Warning
shotList.description: Mr. Mike privately gives Dallas a lucid warning: touching an injured bright creature creates the dark one.

shotList.title: Back Home
shotList.description: Dallas carries the creature and recovered equipment home while Dominic notices the suspicious backpack and invites him to life group.

shotList.title: The Return
shotList.description: Dallas returns through the dark with the injured creature while Dominic checks on him.

shotList.title: Kitchen Triage
shotList.description: Dallas builds a makeshift habitat, studies the creature’s call, and deflects Dominic’s questions before Dominic leaves.

shotList.title: Alone With the Creature
shotList.description: Dallas wakes beside the creature and reviews his recordings while Dominic checks a tire outside.

shotList.title: Resonance
shotList.description: Dallas tunes a soft frequency that calms the creature, then wakes to find it missing.

shotList.title: Normal Day
shotList.description: Dominic works the harbor while Dallas tracks the hum from his attic and the basement map points toward the marsh.

shotList.title: The Drive
shotList.description: Dominic sees the storm’s unnatural pattern in town and confronts Dallas over the phone.

shotList.title: Little Aftermath
shotList.description: Dallas recovers the clean creature recording, then shares a quiet church meal with Dominic as Mr. Mike hears that the song is finally right.

shotList.title: Full Circle
shotList.description: Dallas helps Asher dismantle the woods listening network, accepts a harmless wind spike, reconnects with Dominic, and hears Sierra’s cadence in the creature’s hum.

shotList.title: Asher’s Tracking Box
shotList.description: Asher demonstrates his listening posts, bead-count system, hidden woods lair, trail cameras, recorders, cables, spare oscillator, and contact transducers — Dallas grips in, trips on the signal, and hears Dominic describe the night of the boom.

shotList.title: Mr. Mike’s Warning
shotList.description: Mr. Mike privately gives Dallas a lucid warning: touching an injured bright creature creates the dark one.

shotList.title: Back Home
shotList.description: Dallas carries the creature and recovered equipment home while Dominic notices the suspicious backpack and invites him to life group.

shotList.title: Fellowship
shotList.description: Dominic introduces Dallas to Asher at the fellowship; Asher quietly assembles recording equipment and aims it toward the bushes.

shotList.title: News Vans
shotList.description: Dallas and Dominic pass Pat Clendenen’s storm coverage and discover strange marks near Dominic’s driveway.

shotList.title: Fellowship
shotList.description: Dominic introduces Dallas to Asher at the fellowship; Asher quietly assembles recording equipment and aims it toward the bushes.
